# Guadalupe (Lupe) Holsman

> Multimedia designer in La Plata, Argentina. AI Visual Media Specialist at Black Vitriol and Loomlock, and Creative Marketing Director at EatsBueno. Works in Spanish (native) and English (C1). Available for freelance projects.

Lupe Holsman combines art direction, motion graphics, video editing, illustration and generative AI (Midjourney, Runway, Kling, Veo, ElevenLabs, Adobe Creative Suite) to create brand identities, social content, AI-generated imagery and video. She builds AI agent workflows with Claude, Claude Code, custom Claude Skills and MCP connectors, and also uses ChatGPT and Gemini.
